card.name: Space before a maximum dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or word like 'to') right before a numeric upper limit of a dose, after phrases such as 'maximum daily dose of', 'up to', or 'doses above'. Seen mostly with metformin mg and insulin pen units.

modes.label: Maximum dose wording
modes.description: Space after 'maximum (daily) dose of/is' just before the limit number.
modes.example: may be given to a maximum daily dose of<< >>2550 mg per day.

modes.label: Range or ceiling of pen output
modes.description: Space or 'to' before the top figure of what a pen delivers or a dose ceiling.
modes.example: SOLIQUA 100/33 pen delivers 15 units to<< >>60 units per injection.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like total and season, which suggests it expects a total or limit figure; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up just before the top dose number is written, such as the maximum daily mg or units.
